applicabilityBasis.summary: steakEURCV represents the Ethereum Morpho VaultV2 at 0xbeef0c075da5d01112ae5cf34d257074fb5ddb2f, a yield-accruing EURCV-denominated lending position. The exact product disclosure identifies a lending vault, and its verified protocol source calculates redemption from total assets and share supply after interest, losses and fee-share accrual. Holders burn shares for available underlying EURCV, without a fixed monetary-value redemption obligation from a payment-stablecoin issuer under GENIUS Act section 2(22).

genius.notes: Assessment applies to the steakEURCV vault share separately from underlying EURCV. Current Steakhouse terms identify Carniceria Tropical SA, incorporated in Panama and wholly owned by Steakhouse Financial Ltd, as the service operator and vault curator. They do not establish Carniceria Tropical SA, Steakhouse Financial Ltd or the underlying stablecoin issuer as a legal payment-stablecoin issuer for this vault share; issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted. The exact VaultV2 source realizes investment losses, converts shares using variable total assets and supply, and burns shares before transferring underlying assets on redemption. No GENIUS authorization, foreign registration or issuer pathway is asserted. Underlying EURCV authorizations and reserve reports are not attributed to the vault. This scope assessment does not decide securities, investment-company, adviser, money-transmission or other legal treatment.
